pages.text: Craft a distillery from a flask and copper. A filled flask carries its liquid into the result.

Place a compatible receiver directly against the spout, such as a flask or another native processing tank. Put the batch in the distillery using a filled vessel or the menu input. The outlet indicator tells you if the receiver is missing, ready, or blocked.

pages.title: Provide Heat
pages.text: The block underneath controls speed. Lava runs at 7×, fire or a campfire at 3×, and magma at 2× by default. It can process at the base rate over ordinary blocks. Campfire tags count even when unlit.

pages.title: Collect Spirits
pages.text: On a fermented, unaged brew, each completed stage advances the liquid left in the distillery and sends 1 mB of slurry to the receiver while volume permits. The tank tops out at 16 stages. Draw the spirit from the distillery.

pages.title: Collect Concentrate
pages.text: With flower extract, 2 mB in the distillery yields 1 mB of the next concentration in the receiver. Return the first-pass concentrate for a second pass if needed. Empty the receiver between batches.
